correctness.rationale: All six base points are transverse because the quadratic in the cube of the conic parameter has discriminant lambda squared minus four. The affine elimination x f_x - y f_y=6s H(x cubed - y cubed) exhausts outer candidates; solving on the diagonal gives the one central and three finite node walls. At infinity the binary polynomial has multiple roots only at s=-1/4 and the exact Hessians certify three nodes. At most four nodes and six unibranch cusps imply irreducibility by Bezout (minimum cross-component intersection five). Genus and Tjurina counts follow from local delta and Tjurina invariants. The explicit birational (2,3) model is an integral complete intersection of arithmetic genus four, hence smooth when the plane normalization has genus four, and yields a double cover of a smooth cubic branched in six points. Critical identities and Hessians were independently recalculated in the embedded exact symbolic checker; no finite sample stands in for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is the complete special-fiber bifurcation of a natural symmetric conic/Fermat-cubic torus pencil, not an isolated unmotivated numerical instance: all genus and Tjurina jumps arise at three explicitly computed algebraic walls, two carrying three nodes and one carrying one node, whose distinguished crossing gives a rational six-cuspidal four-nodal curve. The smooth generic normalization has an explicit canonical bielliptic double-cover model, bridging singular plane sextics and elliptic quotients. The exact wall equalities and canonical equations are useful geometric structure not derivable merely from previously listed singularity baskets.
